metadata.model_pooling: fit per model, pool 14 images and two fixed seeds; average derived model quantities
metadata.image_allocation: pooled w held fixed; include -2(1-w)<P,epsilon> per image; only pooled cross vanishes
metadata.primary_frequency: DC excluded, 0<r<0.5, r=max(abs(fx),abs(fy)); 16 bins of width 1/32
metadata.uncertainty: paired image cluster, not training-seed population uncertainty
metadata.interpretation: descriptive endpoint accounting; no causal or held-out prediction claim

extraction_metadata.normalization: sum over FFT coefficients and RGB / (N**4 * 3), once
extraction_metadata.fft: numpy.fft.fft2, float64 input, unnormalized forward transform
extraction_metadata.bin_definition: floor(r*32); bins 0..16; DC excluded and stored separately
extraction_metadata.last_bin: 16 contains the r=0.5 Nyquist outer row/column
extraction_metadata.target_preprocessing: center-crop 240 RGB; float32 /255 as in original run; cast float64 for FFT
extraction_metadata.prediction_precision: frozen float16, cast to float64; no clipping

bootstrap.unit: paired image cluster; seeds fixed; w refit every draw

DIV2K.scope: 32 DIV2K crops, seed1; only six statistics, so H can be localized but epsilon/cross cannot be split
